kit.cover_letter: Dear Hiring Team, I am writing to apply for the MERN Developer – Intern role at Nxtwave Disruptive Technologies Private Limited in Bangalore. As an MCA student at PES University with hands-on full-stack development experience, I am eager to contribute to your engineering team. During my internship at Sunflower Trip, I built a production-ready tours and travel management system using Angular, Node.js, Express, and MySQL, which went live for real customer bookings. Additionally, in my projects like Zenvest and StaySphere, I have gained substantial experience developing full-stack applications using the MERN stack, incorporating secure authentication, RESTful APIs, and database management with MongoDB. My background aligns directly with your technical requirements across JavaScript, React.js, Node.js, and database systems. I look forward to the opportunity to bring my practical development skills to Nxtwave and contribute to your team. Thank you for considering my application. Sincerely, Amaanuddin Ahmed
